name: Doraemon
description: Robotic cat Doraemon is sent back in time from the 22nd century to protect 10-year-old Noby, a lazy and uncoordinated boy who is destined to have a tragic future. Doraemon can create secret gadgets from a pocket on his stomach, but they usually cause more bad than good because of Noby's propensity to misuse them.

videos.title: Star Wars in My Attic
videos.overview:
While enjoying a futuristic space action game borrowed from Doraemon, Nobita is startled when a real miniature spaceship suddenly crashes into his room!

A tiny robot emerges from the spacecraft, introducing himself as a loyal servant of Princess Arle from the planet Lilliput. He begs Nobita to help rescue the princess, who has been captured by the space invaders known as the Akanbeaders.

When Nobita learns that Princess Arle is a beautiful girl who looks just like Shizuka, he sets off to confront the Akanbeaders and save her... But what awaits him on this extraordinary adventure?

videos.title: The Good Ol' Days
videos.overview: After hearing stories from his father about the past, Nobita begins wishing he could live in an older era without school or homework. Ignoring Doraemon’s warnings that life in the past was actually difficult, he travels back in time and ends up in a primitive countryside. A farming family lets him stay with them, but Nobita quickly realizes how harsh life is without modern comforts like television, manga, or proper food. As hunger and discomfort grow, he starts regretting his decision.

videos.title: Goodbye Nobita! Doraemon goes back to the future...
The day Doraemon is reborn
videos.overview: Doraemon is kidnapped by a criminal group targeting caretaker robots, just before his birthday, forcing Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, Suneo, Dorami, and Sewashi to launch a rescue mission. As they uncover a conspiracy involving robot trafficking and a rogue factory manager at Matsushiba Factory, they learn Doraemon risks being reset and losing his memories. Fighting through security drones, mechanical traps, and the crab-like captor, they reach the factory’s core just as Doraemon is about to be erased. In the end, the manager cancels the reset, Doraemon is saved with his memories intact, and he reunites emotionally with Nobita before they return home together.

videos.title: Doraemon's Blue Tears
videos.overview: For Doraemon’s birthday, Nobita and the others gather in the 22nd century to hold a party at Sewashi’s house. While buying a cake, Nobita finds a beautiful bell and gives it to Doraemon as a present, making him very happy. Later, Doraemon reveals he has fallen in love with a flower shop robot named Bell, who suddenly appears searching for the lost bell. Mistaking Bell’s request for help as an invitation to a date, Doraemon excitedly follows her back to the future, while a curious Nobita secretly tags along to see how the “date” unfolds.

videos.title: Doraemon Comes Back
videos.overview: On a cold snowy day, Nobita learns that Doraemon must return to the 22nd century, which leaves him devastated. Despite his initial denial and emotional outburst, including yelling at Doraemon and running away, he slowly begins to understand the situation after his father explains that Doraemon also suffers when Nobita is sad. Realizing he needs to become independent, Nobita accepts the separation. Later, he and Doraemon share a final emotional moment, remembering how they first met and promising to move forward. Doraemon, deeply moved, cries as he leaves, proud of Nobita’s growth.

videos.title: The Beautiful Girl That Loved Nobita
videos.overview: After seeing a blue bird on his way to school, Nobita gets excited and plans to search for it with his classmates, but they abandon him to go to an idol autograph event instead. Feeling disappointed, Nobita returns home and hears a huge explosion coming from his room, where he finds a mysterious glass case containing a sleeping girl. The girl wakes up and introduces herself as Rurii, a care robot sent from the future, but she was actually deployed by an evil organization led by Walser, who plans to use her to eliminate Nobita. Unaware of the danger, Nobita happily befriends Rurii, while the villains secretly prepare their assassination plot.

videos.title: Doraemon's Long Day
videos.overview: On Doraemon’s birthday, Nobita plans a surprise celebration, but the two end up in a huge argument after the dorayaki are ruined. Doraemon angrily returns to the future with Dorami for a medical checkup, but while at the hospital he accidentally swaps bodies with a dangerous fugitive robot named Denja. Taking advantage of Doraemon’s appearance, Denja escapes and heads toward Nobita in the 21st century, while the real Doraemon, trapped in Denja’s body, desperately tries to return home and warn everyone before it’s too late.

videos.title: Battle! Cat-Model Robots vs. Dog-Model Robots
videos.overview: It's the birthday of the cat-shaped robots, and Dorami and Sewashi are searching a present for Doraemon in the 22nd century. But during a chain of gas attacks on the cat robots under a scheme to replace them with dog robots, Dorami is wrongfully taken away, so Sewashi goes to the dog robot factory to protest against the decision. Back in the 21st century, Nobita gets a new robot companion, Wonderful, who watches over him as he does his homework. A group of breakaway cat robots led by Pawaemon take Doraemon into hiding, but when the latter accidentally causes the others to get sent to scrap, he is left on his own as Nobita goes back to the future to save Doraemon and all the cat robots.

videos.title: Move Fast, Doraemon! The Galactic Grandprix
The Great Escape from the "Thank You Very Much" Prison
videos.overview: On the first day of school, Nobita panics because he still hasn’t finished his summer homework. Using Doraemon’s “What-If Phone Booth” without permission, he creates a world where nobody is allowed to scold anyone. At first Nobita loves this carefree world, but when Doraemon travels to the 22nd century for his birthday reunion, he discovers the rule has affected the future as well, where scolding is now illegal. After accidentally reprimanding some children, Doraemon is arrested and sent to a robot detention center. Nobita must then find a way to save him in an emotional story about their friendship and bond.

videos.title: A Hundred Miles Underground Mission
videos.overview: On Doraemon’s birthday, Nobita wants to give him a special surprise gift and becomes interested in finding a rumored rainbow-colored butterfly. After returning home disappointed by Gian and Suneo’s prank, he discovers Doraemon repairing a machine that can travel underground. Suddenly, a mysterious masked girl named Lapis appears and drags Nobita and Doraemon into an underground treasure hunt, claiming to be a genius scientist from space. Meanwhile, Dorami learns that Doraemon may have been kidnapped by a dangerous criminal and teams up with the future police to track them down. The adventure soon turns into a thrilling underground mystery involving hidden treasure, the rainbow butterfly, and Lapis’s true identity.

videos.title: Nobita Express and the Mystery of the Train Hunter
videos.overview: On the night before Doraemon’s birthday, Nobita plans a surprise birthday trip with Dorami, Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo while his parents are away. Using a special gadget, Nobita’s house transforms into the “Nobita Express,” a fully functioning train driven by Nobita himself. The group enjoys the journey until mysterious train hunters from the future steal the train with Doraemon, Shizuka, and Gian still inside. Nobita and a sheep conductor then set out to rescue their friends and recover the stolen Nobita Express.

videos.title: The Mystery of the Pyramids!? The Great Egyptian Adventure
videos.overview: Nobita, inspired by Suneo’s stories about Egyptian pyramids and hidden treasures, decides to travel to Egypt with Doraemon using futuristic gadgets like the Anywhere Door and Time Belt. There, they discover a royal tomb and meet Nemses II, a young pharaoh who reveals he was betrayed and trapped by a usurper named Warueheb. After bringing Nemses back to the present to understand the situation, Nobita and his friends (Shizuka, Gian, and Suneo) return to ancient Egypt to help him reclaim his throne. They soon realize Warueheb has used Nobita’s lost Future Diary to gain power and control over the kingdom. An epic adventure begins as they try to restore justice and save Egypt.

videos.title: The Dandelions Fly Off into the Sky
The Substitution Rope Story
videos.overview: Nobita, hearing Shizuka's wish to climb trees and play baseball, suggests, "Well, let's try switching bodies for a while!" He borrows a "Switching Rope" from Doraemon, which allows them to switch bodies while keeping their minds the same. The two immediately switch bodies. Shizuka, now in Nobita's form, is overjoyed to enjoy tree climbing, something she had always wanted, and to do well in baseball. She says she wants to stay like this for a while. Meanwhile, Nobita is constantly being scolded by Shizuka's mother for "misbehaving badly"...!?

The Devil Passport
videos.overview:
Nobita wants to buy a manga book and asks for an advance on his allowance, but his mom firmly refuses. Unable to give up, he tries to secretly get the money early, but gets scolded and becomes discouraged. Frustrated, he decides, “If that’s how it is, I’ll just become a total villain!” and takes the “Devil’s Passport” from Doraemon. It is a terrifying passport that allows him to get away with any wrongdoing.

Freed from being scolded, Nobita begins doing only bad things (like kicking empty cans and trash bags) taking advantage of the fact that no one can punish him.

My Birthday is the Same as Always
videos.overview: Even though it’s his birthday, Nobita feels disappointed because he worries his parents’ present will once again not match what he wanted. Trying to distract himself, he visits Shizuka’s house, but while waiting for her to return, he becomes impatient and asks Doraemon for a way to skip wasted time. Doraemon then introduces the “Time Warp Reel,” a gadget that allows them to jump forward in time, leading Nobita to experiment with fast-forwarding to the moment Shizuka comes home.

Zou no Hana ni Natta Shizuka-chan
3cm Nobita's Adventures
videos.overview: During summer vacation, Nobita is accidentally stranded after drifting away in a tiny bamboo boat while shrunk by Doraemon’s “Gulliver Tunnel.” Doraemon and Shizuka try to rescue him, but Gian and Suneo insist on shrinking down too so they can experience the miniature world themselves. As the group travels through the dangerous micro-world to find Nobita, they are attacked by a crow while riding a balloon raft. In the chaos, Doraemon accidentally drops the “Big Light,” the gadget needed to restore their normal size, making the rescue even more difficult.

I Love You, Roboko
videos.overview: Nobita becomes overjoyed after being praised by girls for his ability to catch peanuts in his mouth. However, he later discovers that they only praised him out of politeness, leaving him deeply disappointed. Feeling sorry for him, Doraemon brings a “Friend Robot” named Robo-ko from the future, programmed to love only Nobita. Robo-ko is not only cute but also constantly praises everything Nobita does, making him extremely happy. However, she gradually begins to become overly possessive of him, trying to keep him all to herself.

videos.title: The Dwarf Robot
videos.overview: Nobita is scolded by his mom for napping instead of doing homework, and wishes for a tool like in fairy tales that can do work while he sleeps. Doraemon gives him the “Little Helper Box,” which summons tiny robots to complete any task requested before sleeping. Nobita first tests it with small chores like polishing shoes, and the robots successfully complete everything. Encouraged by this, he starts using the box to help others with increasingly larger tasks, gaining praise and confidence, but eventually becomes overconfident and takes on too many requests.

videos.title: Hito no Mi ni Naru Tachibagan
Convenient Treasure Island
videos.overview: Nobita and his friends go on a sea adventure as part of a spring break request, with Doraemon using a gadget to create a “moderate” treasure island experience. They are guided by a dolphin-like robot named Hodho, but the adventure turns strange when the treasure they find is just merchandise instead of real riches. After Gian and Suneo complain, Doraemon increases the difficulty, leading to real danger: storms, malfunctioning gadgets, and transformations into sea creatures to survive. The group eventually discovers the true treasure inside a whale, but the adventure keeps shifting between too easy and too hard, leaving them confused as Hodho insists everything is “just right.”

videos.title: Hanbun no Hanbun no Mata Hanbun...
Toki o Hashire! Time Karimono Kyousou
Hitoban de Kaki no Makoto ga Natta
All alone in the city of the future
videos.overview: Nobita travels to the 22nd century after Doraemon leaves, only to discover a seemingly deserted futuristic city where he encounters anti-gravity tech, strange shops, and what he believes is an alien invasion. He meets Sewashi, who explains everything is actually part of a 3D game called “Intruders,” not a real crisis. Embarrassed but relieved, Nobita learns Doraemon was only temporarily away for repairs. Doraemon later returns, and they go back to the 20th century together, where Nobita immediately wants to keep playing the game.

videos.title: Let's Skate on the Moon Craters!
videos.overview: Nobita is mocked by Gian and Suneo at the park for not being able to skateboard, though Suneo gives him an old board to try. Feeling frustrated, Nobita asks Doraemon for help, and Doraemon brings a gadget called the “Otasuke Hat,” which is meant to prevent injuries when falling from sliding sports. However, Nobita is too scared of falling and cannot use it properly. Later, Shizuka arrives and skillfully rides a skateboard while wearing the hat, impressing everyone. Doraemon becomes disappointed in Nobita’s fear, though he reflects that Nobita might feel more confident in a lighter-gravity environment.

videos.title: Is it okay if Doraemon isn't around?!
videos.overview: Doraemon received several sample items from the future department store like a Raw Material Lights. He doesn't need all the sample gadgets offered and threw them in the trash. But for Nobita this is an interesting thing. Then Nobita bring a shopping bag and put all the sample gadgets into the bag. Before Nobita left the house he accidentally use Raw Material Lights to turn Doraemon's Dorayaki into raw materials, this make Doraemon angry with him.

videos.title: Nobita will disappear?
videos.overview: Nobita becomes anxious after a situation makes him think he might vanish from existence. As he spirals into worry, Doraemon uses his gadgets to investigate and help him understand what’s really happening. The episode mixes comedy with a more unsettling idea, showing Nobita’s fear of being forgotten and the reassurance he finds through Doraemon’s support.
